title: Vascular smooth muscle cells differentiation from hPSCs
protocol: Resuspend 10mg of CHIR-99021 in 5ml DMSO.
Store the CHIR-99021 solution at -80°C or -20°C for a year.
Resuspend 2mg of CP21R in 630μl DMSO.
Store the CP21R solution at -80°C or -20°C for a year.
Resuspend 10ug of BMP4 in 4ml of 5-10mM citric acid pH 3.
Store the BMP4 solution at -80°C or -20°C for a year.
Dissolve 100μg of VEGF165 in 1ml sterile water.
Store the VEGF165 solution at -80°C or -20°C for a year.
Dissolve 10mg of forskolin in 2.436ml DMSO.
Store the forskolin solution at -20°C for a month.
Dissolve 100μg of Activin A in 1ml sterile water.
Store the Activin A solution at -80°C or -20°C for a year.
Dissolve 100μg of PDGF-BB in 1ml sterile water.
Store the PDGF-BB solution at -80°C or -20°C for a year.
Coat one T175 flask with growth factor reduced matrigel by thawing it on ice and diluting it 1:30.
Incubate the flasks at room temperature for 1 hour.
Aspirate the matrigel, wash once with PBS, and add 20 ml of pre-warmed mTeSR1 + ROCK-Inhibitor (final concentration 10 µM).
Aspirate growth medium from an 80% confluent 10 cm plate.
Wash with 10 ml of pre-warmed PBS (Ca²⁺ and Mg²⁺ free).
Add 3 ml of pre-warmed Accutase and incubate at 37°C for 3-7 minutes.
Check cells' detachment under a microscope.
Add 3 ml of pre-warmed mTeSR1.
Transfer cells to a 15 ml Falcon tube.
Count the cells.
Centrifuge the suspension at 1000 rpm (210 g) for 5 minutes.
Aspirate supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet in 10 ml of pre-warmed mTeSR1 + ROCK-Inhibitor (final concentration 10 µM).
Seed the cells at 37,000 to 47,000 hPSCs per cm².
Incubate the cells at 37°C with 5% CO₂ overnight.
Replace media with pre-warmed N2B27 Medium supplemented with 6-8 µM CHIR-99021 or 1 µM CP21 + 25 ng/ml hBMP4 for 3 days without medium change.
Replace Media with N2B27 Medium supplemented with 10 ng/ml PDGF-BB and 2 ng/ml ActivinA every day for two days.
Seed 30,000 cells/cm² in synthetic condition on gelatin-coated wells using N2B27 + PDGF-BB (10 ng/ml).
Seed 30,000 cells/cm² in contractile condition on collagen-coated wells using N2B27 + ActivinA (2 ng/ml) + Heparin (1:1000 final concentration 2 µg/ml).
